description: Post a comment on a market. Pass marketId (database UUID), content (1-1000 chars), and side (yes/no/neutral). Optionally include parentId for replies. Market must be open or pending. Rate limited to 3 per market per 5 minutes.

marketId.description: Market UUID (NOT the contract address). Get it from list_markets / get_market via the 'id' field.

side.description: Side of the market the comment supports.

name: post_comment
